places.name: Siachen Glacier
places.text: Radar Point 1001. Lt. Kiran feels a power surge to the east seconds before the wall comes down. Shan's first strike on Bharatvarsh, 2189.

places.name: Delhi
places.text: The old capital. Fifteen squadrons of X-90s scramble from Palam Air Base. Raj Vetramani falls here and Shan's bolt beam levels the city. It was never rebuilt.

places.name: Jaipur
places.text: Capital since Delhi fell, split between locals and refugees from the north. Home of the Verakhonda Museum and the black sais in its inner chamber.

places.name: Mumbai
places.text: The University of Excellence sits closer to the sea than the city's own beaches. The Rathores live at 919 Vardhan Street, and Abhimanyu washes plates at Bhojan Darbar.

places.name: Kiraj
places.text: 180 miles from Bombay. The astrals' doomsday bunker. The FS 60 never reaches it. A tributary of the Satvati runs five miles beyond, below the cliff where Veraya makes her stand.

places.name: Mysore
places.text: Government facility holding the neutronium a student is not allowed to touch.

places.name: Pondicherry
places.text: Raj's team draws Titanus Merwah away and pays for it. They are still scarred when Shan arrives.

places.name: Zhongguo
places.text: Shan Zhuang's seat. The Philippines, Korea and Myanmar have already fallen in line.

places.name: Kyoto
places.text: It took three astrals together to bring down the one that hit Kyoto.

places.name: Leizpez
places.text: Where Raj chased the Artifact's trail while Delhi waited for him.

places.name: Nairobi
places.text: Destroyed in a recent monster attack. The astrals got the population out.

places.name: Off the Horn of Africa
places.text: Off the Horn of Africa, 2204. Titanus Spewah rises as a golden eagle dives from Sanghvi's cargo plane.

places.name: Southern Landmass
places.text: A continent between the Indian and Southern Oceans. Its name and its story arrive in later chapters.

lore.text: Humans chosen to harness astral energy. Each nation that has them leans on them against calamities, and fears them in equal measure. Astral energy obeys no known law of physics.
The creature an astral can become at full power. Raj's ice beast, Prayan's magma phoenix, Shan's lightning dragon.
Every astral carries one. When an astral dies, the weapon's power dies too, which is why an unregistered weapon that still feels alive is a problem.
The event that brought the first astrals. Shan has been fighting since, and split Mt. Nayamusa during it.
Named monsters that can take a city. Titanus Merwah left a massacre the government could not stop in 2189. Titanus Spewah rose in the Arabian Sea in 2204.
The other things that roam when astrals are not watching. Hybrids still haunt the Sahyadri forests.
A box holding a pendant, imprinted with a three-eyed winged creature that does not exist. Delhi's scientists call it junk. A Titan carried it, and Shan burned a capital looking for it.
The international body astrals are supposed to answer to, and that new weapons are supposed to be reported to.
Vanta Singhania's outfit. Assassinations across several countries, with Butcher as the blade.
Mumbai's school for the country's best minds: astral science, meta species, human biology, and mostly defence technology.
Government-controlled. Fifty nanograms of it collapse into the mini black hole at the core of Abhimanyu's time dilator.
Currency. One wash of the fountain's heating motor costs 20,000.
Bharatvarsh's heaviest conventional weapon. Shan splits them in half with a light field.
The X-90 is the air force's front-line jet. The FS 60 is a supersonic road car with stealth no military radar can see, until Shan does.
